decisions: vloop owns the whole .vloop/README.md; upgrade regenerates it rather than merging local edits. I agree: the explicit restore and current-version behavior matches a generated owned file.
vloop upgrade always restores a missing README, and there is no opt-out. I agree: this is the operator-approved ownership decision.
vloop self-update does not write repositories; each repository is refreshed by vloop upgrade. I agree: it preserves B44's boundary.
The README is descriptive, stays within 400 words, and covers four content sections plus the ownership notice. I agree.
init uses the selected/init-resolved language; upgrade uses the resolved language config, defaulting to en. I agree: this follows existing generated-file language behavior.
Generated files use LF line endings. I agree: this matches existing file writes.
The setup guide gains a sentence naming init's write and upgrade's rewrite-or-restore behavior. I agree: the existing setup section is the right documentation surface.
checked: facts, consistency, rules, runnability; brief check on a ready copy and the repository base check
